cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere established by a wind instrument, evoking a sense of ancient solitude.
cards.palette: A solo bamboo flute (Dizi) serves as the primary melodic voice in the intro and outro, carrying the main motif with an expressive, breathy tone.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, wistful atmosphere established by a lone wind instrument, setting a tone of historical melancholy.
cards.palette: A solo bamboo flute (Dizi) serves as the primary melodic voice in the introduction and interludes, characterized by its airy, breathy tone and expressive vibrato.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere established by traditional instrumentation, evoking a sense of ancient solitude.
cards.palette: A bowed string instrument (resembling an Erhu) serves as the primary melodic voice, introducing the main theme in the intro and weaving counter-melodies around the vocal line throughout the verses and choruses.
